title: Crowdsourcing with Fairness, Diversity and Budget Constraints
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on ensuring fairness with respect to sensitive attributes, with race being the specific attribute used in the experiments.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its key findings relate to a proposed algorithm that can optimize the accuracy of crowdsourced labels while satisfying fairness constraints (related to race) under a budget.
